protocol.purpose: First independent larger-basis relative-energy test of the variable-sector physical tensor family
protocol.initialization: One CUDA integral/RHF preparation per new geometry, full basis, pure singlet determinant; no correlated density, label or fitted parameter
protocol.capacity: One a priori 128-state spin-complete bound for the changed family; no rank/seed/iteration campaign and no change after chemical reference inspection
protocol.truncation: Spin-complete physical Schmidt retraction; reject energy-increasing candidates, retain every rejection and use the original stopping/audit
protocol.reference_use: Both predictions and frozen common-context audits finish before either reference. If either prediction fails its gate, do not spend a reference campaign on this protocol. Independent six-particle singlet-projected CUDA reference action starts from its own determinant only afterward.
protocol.scope: Two new full cc-pVDZ finite-basis predictions and one balanced stretch contrast; development evidence, not CBS/GMTKN55, WTMAD-2, an arbitrary-density XC model or proof of broad generalization
protocol.resource_limit: One CUDA job and one host core; at most 1 GB new disk inside 32 GB working/40 GB total; no CPU scientific fallback

reference_seed_correctness_amendment.purpose: Correct independent ground-state reference coverage before any reference has been generated or inspected
reference_seed_correctness_amendment.supersedes: The determinant-only reference starting vector in tensor_bh_accuracy_protocol_20261117.json; all prediction settings and reference capacity/stopping thresholds remain unchanged
reference_seed_correctness_amendment.starting_vector: Equal-norm sum of the independent closed-shell determinant and one fixed generic CUDA random vector projected into the complete singlet space; normalize once. The generic component is not restricted to the determinant's extra spatial symmetries.
reference_seed_correctness_amendment.reason: A determinant-only Krylov start may remain in one spatial-symmetry sector and miss a lower singlet in a different sector. The independent reference must cover the full intended spin space.

interruption_history.reason: User requested GPU worker termination to use the GPU for another task; user will restart

interruption.reason: User paused goal while requesting GPU/accuracy status; background scientific worker stopped and checkpoint retained
